title: Ordinary Portland Cement — Specification (Sixth Revision)
scope: This standard covers the manufacture and chemical and physical requirements of 33 grade, 43 grade and 53 grade ordinary portland cement.

clauses.title: Chemical Requirements
clauses.content: Total loss on ignition shall not exceed 5.0 percent by mass. Insoluble residue shall not exceed 5.0 percent by mass.

clauses.title: Fineness
clauses.content: The specific surface shall not be less than 225 m2/kg when tested by the air permeability method in accordance with IS 4031 (Part 2).

clauses.title: Soundness
clauses.content: Unaerated cement shall not have an expansion of more than 10 mm when tested by the Le Chatelier method according to IS 4031 (Part 3).

clauses.title: Compressive Strength
clauses.content: The average compressive strength of at least three mortar cubes (area of face 50 cm2) shall not be less than: 72 h: 27 MPa, 168 h: 37 MPa, 672 h: 53 MPa for 53 grade cement.
